# Changelog

## 0.1.0

- Initial modern Fortran/FPM translation of RPEIF 1.2.5.
- Added all 14 influence-function families.
- Added typed nuisance parameters and result objects.
- Added robust cleaning and robust mean support using translated RobStatTM psi
  functions.
- Added self-contained quantiles, normal functions, KDE, and AR prewhitening.
- Added source-compatible and corrected modes for documented upstream issues.
- Added five tests, an example, FPM metadata, Makefile, and build scripts.
